raw_html: [[Legendary Earthgrab Guard|Legendary Earthgrab Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Earthgrab Guard]]:''' This item stores the implacable strength of the earth deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally comes to the surface, calling on the earth to erupt from the ground and hold an enemy in place.
